svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Beams: two 40 x 40 x 2 tubes 2,000 long, one over each pair of posts,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reaching 100 past the front and the back post centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fix each beam to its post tops with a 40 x 40 x 4 angle cleat and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two M8 bolts, or weld it on site.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Purlins: four 40 x 20 x 2 tubes 1,500 long across the beams, at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30, 660, 1,300 and 1,940 from the beams' front ends; weld or bolt

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with an M8 bolt through each crossing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roof sheet: corrugated galvanised 1,500 x 2,050, fixed to each purlin

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with roofing screws and washers on every second crest.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the roof falls 5 deg to the back; no sheet edge overhangs a
